edgeAATolerance.reason: Hairline strokes at 1.25, 2.5 and 3.1 px (issue #63). Measured on CI 39579399339 (3 identical runs): maxInBand 102, over-32 pixels 2023 of 15936 band pixels (12.69%), mean 8.15, out-of-band 0. Positions and centres match Mac; the renderer quantises edge coverage (GPUI path 4x MSAA gives 0.5/0.75 steps; rect quad borders snap their outer edge, 2.3 px drawn for 2.5 px), so widths differ by up to 0.5 px. tolerance = measured plus about 15%.
